events.summary: Goddric reveals his true identity and douses redcap raiders in dragonfire at the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh.
events.quote: Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

events.summary: Sorin is forced to end Avacyn, whom he created.
events.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

events.summary: Liliana whispers to the remnants of Oketra and Bontu.
events.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

events.summary: Caparocti pierces Clavileno's tainted heart after weeping for Inti.
events.quote: Though he wept at Inti's death, Caparocti's eyes were keen, and his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileño's tainted heart.

events.summary: Odum and Broadbark fight Moran for a hundred dawns until Moran sleeps and wakes as the Gardener.
events.quote: Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep.

events.summary: Anafenza Mevak's Kin-Tree is recovered after Dromoka's reign.
events.quote: The Kin-Tree of Anafenza Mevak was the first recovered after Dromoka's reign

events.summary: Ash walks away as a helmet clatters to a stop before silent partygoers.
events.quote: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared.

events.summary: Jace discovers that the cryptoliths point to Drownyard Temple.
events.quote: "This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!" —Jace Beleren

events.summary: The Jeskai restore their lost archives from a draconic keeper.
events.quote: Wresting them from their draconic keeper proved much more challenging.

relations.note: It fell upon Sorin to end her.
relations.quote: it fell upon him to end her forever

relations.note: The Abzan will not tolerate Zurgo's marauders.
relations.quote: Remind Zurgo that the Abzan will not tolerate his marauders.

relations.note: They battled for a hundred dawns.
relations.quote: Odum and Broadbark were the only beings mighty enough to challenge the giant Moran the Destroyer.
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone." —Danitha
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way." —Nissa Revane
